remarks: Sunny and elegant one-bedroom residence located on the first floor of the desirable Heritage Hill condo association. This well-designed condominium features new windows, exceptional closet storage, and a frosted paneled glass door that separates the bedroom suite from the living space. Enjoy a garden area just outside and two outdoor pools for summer enjoyment. Extra storage, and laundry facilities located in the basement. Ideally situated within walking distance to all of the New Canaan Town amenities as well as the Metro-North train to NYC for easy commuting.
